content:
Commit messages follow conventional commits
Write every commit message as a conventional commit (feat:, fix:, docs:, chore:) with a lowercase summary of at most 72 characters.

Explain a change by its effect first
When describing a change, say what it changes for whoever uses the project before saying how the code does it.

Timestamps are UTC
Every timestamp the project writes, in logs, files or APIs, is UTC in ISO 8601 with a trailing Z; local time is only for display.

Pull requests say how they were tested
Every pull request description ends with a Testing section naming the commands that were run.

Python strings are formatted with f-strings
Format strings with f-strings, not with % or str.format, in every Python module.

Markdown headings are in sentence case
Write Markdown headings in sentence case: only the first word and proper names start with a capital letter.

TypeScript modules use named exports
TypeScript modules export by name and never with export default, so that a rename is caught by the compiler.

Go errors are wrapped with their operation
Wrap every returned error with fmt.Errorf and %w, naming the operation that failed.

Containers run as a non-root user
Every Dockerfile ends with a USER line naming a user other than root.

Database migrations are never edited
A migration that reached the main branch is never changed; a fix goes in a new migration.

CI workflows cancel outdated runs
Every GitHub Actions workflow sets a concurrency group with cancel-in-progress, so that a new push stops the run of the previous one.

Rust library errors use thiserror
Errors of a library crate are enums that derive thiserror::Error; unwrap and expect are only for tests.

Colors come from the design tokens
Stylesheets never write a raw hex color; they use the variables of tokens.css.

Java services use constructor injection
Inject a dependency through the constructor, never with field injection.

Terraform keeps its state in the shared backend
Every Terraform root module declares the shared remote backend, and no state file is committed.
